data.name: Aaqilah
data.gender_notes: Aaqilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aaqilah is derived from the Arabic word 'Aqilah', which means 'wise' or 'intelligent'. This name is often given to girls in the Islamic world due to its spiritual significance and positive connotations. The name Aaqilah carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaqilah usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aaqilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaqilah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It is a popular given name in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing the qualities of a wise and intelligent woman.

Aaqilah ibn Abi Talib was a companion of Prophet Muhammad and one of the early converts to Islam. He was known for his wisdom and piety, and was often consulted for advice by the Prophet himself. Aaqilah is also mentioned in several Hadiths.
